title: 7 · Which route do I take?
labels: What is the question asking for?
The tell, when two of them look alike
True altitude and density altitude both take an altitude and a temperature and give you a height.
Ask what the answer is for: clearing the ground, or predicting the climb.
Two sign checks that catch almost every error in this chapter
COLD day → true altitude is LOWER than indicated. You have less clearance, not more.
HOT day → density altitude is HIGHER than pressure altitude. You have less performance.
Both bad conditions push the number the way that costs you something. That is how you remember them.
